recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future refinement should be handled in CRMI or extension-pack work about expansion parameters, not by changing the core CodeSystem source for FHIR-45036.
issue_request: FHIR-45036 asked for a universal way to identify the code system version in which an inactive concept was last active. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution changed the requested extension into a standard string concept property, LastVersionActive/lastVersionActive, in the common concept properties list and concept-property CodeSystem.
initial_application: Git commit 6b17a90151d18b14c3f144c8b16db05dfb41b043 added lastVersionActive to source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-properties.xml and source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml. The current combined branch contains those entries, and source/fhir.ini lists codesystem=CodeSystem as an active resource.
additional_context: Vocabulary minutes from 2025-07-28 record the move from an extension request to a code system property. Later related work stayed consistent: FHIR-55965 was resolved no-change because concept properties were used instead of an extension, and FHIR-54026 updated CRMI expansion behavior to use the lastVersionActive concept property.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was necessary because the current build-scoped core source already satisfies both source locations called out in the Jira comments.

related_jiras.note: CRMI later renamed lastActiveVersion behavior to includeLastVersionActive and specified returning the core lastVersionActive concept property. It was context only because it belongs to FHIR-crmi, not this core source reconciliation.
The extension-pack proposal for concept-lastActiveVersion was resolved no-change because the use case should be represented with concept properties.
A sibling lastVersionPresent property was later added in the same CodeSystem area and does not change the FHIR-45036 lastVersionActive conclusion.
